# Phool Pattiyan

Premium florist and fresh flower delivery service in Lahore, Pakistan.

## Business

Phool Pattiyan (meaning "flowers and leaves") is a Lahore-based florist and WhatsApp ordering flower shop at Plaza 24, B Block Bankers, Ground Floor — near DHA Phase 4, State Life Housing Society and Lake City.

## Services

- Fresh floral bouquets
- Fresh flowers Lahore
- Birthday decoration and birthday flowers
- Birthday bouquet delivery
- Shadi (wedding) function flowers
- Mehndi function flowers and décor
- Gajra and gajray (floral hair accessories)
- Floral jewellery and flower jewelry
- Bridal bouquets
- Groom garlands and barat garlands
- Wedding car decoration
- Room decoration
- Floral boxes and gift boxes
- Floral and chocolate bouquets
- Gift baskets
- Money bouquets
- Crochet flowers
- Same-day flower delivery (subject to confirmation)
- Custom floral designs via WhatsApp

## Delivery

Flower and gift delivery across Lahore including DHA, State Life, Bankers Town, Lake City, Valencia Town, Wapda Town, Johar Town and Khayaban-e-Amin.

## Ordering

Orders placed via WhatsApp. No online card checkout. 10% advance typically required.
